title: Supplementary personnel screening needs dated authorization evidence
remediation: The deployment personnel security authority and access sponsor approve screening criteria, case custody and rescreening triggers for the assessed roles. Verify a redacted timeline from an authorized screening disposition to initial access approval and select a rescreening case or exercise. Retain role and date evidence and protected case references in place of personal screening contents.

milestones.title: Collect approved screening and rescreening criteria, a dated pre-access verification, and a protected rescreening review reference
